ideas.name: Treasury auction bid-to-cover and 10y futures return
ideas.claim: After a Treasury auction, high bid-to-cover (above average) is followed by positive 10y note futures returns and lower volatility.
ideas.quote: Higher bid‐to‐cover ratios, and bid‐to‐cover ratios that exceed the average, lead to positive returns and lower return volatility.

rules.entry: long after auction when bid-to-cover above its average

ideas.name: Treasury auction price pressure reversal
ideas.claim: Yields rise in the hours before a Treasury auction and reverse afterward, stronger when dealers are constrained.
ideas.quote: Using 33 years of intraday Treasury data, we provide the first high-frequency evidence on auction-day price pressure: yields rise in the hours before auction and reverse afterward.

rules.entry: short Treasuries before auction, cover after (implied)

ideas.claimed_result: not stated; paper says price pressure has not increased in recent years

ideas.name: Dealer fixed-income positioning tracks expected returns
ideas.claim: Dealer share of debt securities in financial assets co-moves with expected fixed-income returns.
ideas.quote: a very tight correlation (55 percent) between expected fixed-income returns and dealer fixed-income positioning.
